Title: Green Climate Fund approves US$140m for green hydrogen in Namibia and South Africa
Summary: US$56m (about N$1bn) goes to the SDG Namibia One Fund: US$15m for project development and US$41m for construction equity. US$84m goes to the SA-H2 Fund. Instrument (grant, loan or equity) not specified.
Note: Date is the article date; GCF board meeting date not given.

Title: Hyphen final investment decision delayed to end-2027
Summary: FID pushed to the end of 2027. AfDB announced a reimbursable grant of about N$100m in Sept 2026, after US$10m in Dec 2025. Government holds 24% through SDG Namibia One. Offtake questions raised.

Title: Hyphen still in feasibility; RWE offtake MoU lapsed
Summary: Original plan was exports before 2025 and production in 2026. RWE's non-binding 2022 MoU (about 300,000 t ammonia a year) ended in Sept 2025. Project cost US$10bn per AfDB (Phase 1: 1.5 GW electrolyser).

Title: Green hydrogen bill still in consultation
Summary: National Green Hydrogen Policy was completed in 2025. Draft bill expected in Parliament by end-2026. Minister says existing laws are sufficient for now.

Title: Government signals total commitment to Hyphen
Summary: Government reaffirms support; 24% state stake held through SDG Namibia One (taken up Dec 2023 per The Namibian).
Note: Page could not be read. Date taken from the article URL; stake confirmed elsewhere.

Title: AfDB approves US$10m SEFA loan for Hyphen FEED studies
Summary: Pre-investment facility from the Sustainable Energy Fund for Africa for front-end engineering and design. Government forecasts 15,000 construction jobs and 3,000 permanent jobs (forecasts, not created jobs).

Title: Namibia green hydrogen sector: N$2.08bn committed to date
Summary: Cumulative total committed to date (NGH2P Mid-Year Review 2025), not a single new deal. More than 800 Namibians employed; about N$170m spent with local SMEs.

Title: Cabinet reviewing draft National Green Hydrogen Policy
Summary: Draft policy under Cabinet review. By June 2026 officials described the policy as completed in 2025; formal approval date not found.
Note: Month only; day set to the 1st. Replaces 2025-04-01 'draft finalized'.

Title: Namibia ranked 3rd of 26 in the CIF Industry Decarbonization Programme
Summary: Namibia invited to prepare an investment plan to mobilise up to US$250m in concessional capital from the US$1bn programme. Not yet awarded or disbursed.
Note: Replaces 2025-01-01 and the '~1% USD interest' claim (not in this source).

Title: EU and Netherlands pledge N$258m (EUR 12.9m) grant to SDG Namibia One Fund
Summary: Grant to the blended-finance fund targeting US$1bn; announced ahead of the HyIron-Oshivela inauguration. The fund holds the 24% Hyphen stake.

Title: HyIron-Oshivela inaugurated; plan to scale from 15,000 to 200,000 t a year
Summary: Joint Namibian-German project near Arandis entering its second operational phase.

Title: HyIron Oshivela produces first green hydrogen
Summary: 12 MW electrolyser, 25 MW solar and 13.4 MW battery. Described as the largest of its kind in Southern Africa. Direct reduced iron followed (Financial Mail, 10 Apr 2025).
Note: Original said 'green hydrogen-powered iron' and 'Southern Hemisphere'; sources say first green hydrogen and Southern Africa.

Title: Cross-border hydrogen pipeline pre-feasibility completed
Summary: Pre-feasibility confirmed potential for Luderitz to Boegoebaai and Saldanha Bay, with a possible extension to Gauteng. N$30m master plan scheduled mid-2025 to mid-2026.
Note: Original said Dec 2025. Month only; day set to the 1st.
